## Problem and scope

Describe the problem, related issue, and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Verification

List exact tests/checks run and their results. State anything not tested or blocked.
For UI changes, use only harmless local demo content in screenshots.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the MIT License.
- [ ] No credentials, private student/course data, assignment answers, source-preview screenshots or local agent artifacts are included.
- [ ] Consent, assessment refusal, targeting/identity checks and replacement confirmation remain intact.
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change, including relevant refusal paths.
- [ ] Browser fixtures are not presented as proof of native permissions or site saving/submission.
